intro: UCS generations arrive in waves. M8 first appeared in AMD systems in 2024; Intel rack and modular models followed in 2025, and additional edge nodes in 2026. A generation year does not date every model or every CPU/GPU option.

generations.label: UCS M5
generations.summary: The M5 rack and blade generation was announced in July 2017.

generations.label: UCS M6
generations.summary: B200, C220 and C240 M6 were announced in April 2021.

generations.label: X-Series family
generations.summary: The modular X-Series began in June 2021. Its chassis family spans multiple compute-node generations.

generations.label: UCS M7
generations.summary: M7 C-Series and X-Series were introduced in January 2023.

generations.label: UCS M8
generations.summary: C245 M8 was first announced in February 2024; C225 and X215c joined the June 2024 AMD rollout. Intel C220, C240 and X210c M8 followed in February 2025.

generations.label: Unified Edge family
generations.summary: The XE9305 platform and XE130c M8 were announced in November 2025; XE150c M8 followed in March 2026.

c220.note: Announced 24 February 2025 as part of the Intel M8 rollout, after M8 began with AMD systems.

c240.note: Announced 24 February 2025 in the Intel M8 rollout.

c225.note: Named in Cisco's 4 June 2024 announcement. Later CPU qualification does not reset the server's introduction year.

c245.note: First announced 6 February 2024. The June portfolio announcement named C245 again alongside C225 and X215c.

c845.note: C845A M8 was introduced at Cisco Live Amsterdam on 11 February 2025. Newer GPU options can arrive later.

c880.note: Cisco's support index gives this model a release date of 25 August 2025.

c885.note: Announced 29 October 2024. Accelerator variants and their lifecycle notices have separate dates.

x210.note: Announced 24 February 2025. The X-Series chassis family itself dates to 2021.

x215.note: Announced 4 June 2024. This is a compute-node date, not the X-Series chassis debut.

x410.note: Cisco's model data sheet is dated 4 December 2025. This establishes documentation by 2025, not an exact first-shipment date.

xe130.note: XE130c M8 was part of the initial Unified Edge announcement on 3 November 2025.

xe150.note: Announced 16 March 2026. It is a later node in the Unified Edge family, which began in 2025.

c245m6.note: C245 M6 was named in Cisco’s 15 March 2021 EPYC 7003 announcement.

c225m6.note: C225 M6 announced 15 March 2021; independent of the later Intel M6 rollout.
